name: Douyin creator center

guide.zh: 视频上传后页面会跳到发布设置，标题和简介会自动填好。封面请点「选择封面」自己选。最后由你点「发布」。
guide.en: After the video uploads the page moves to the post settings; title and description are filled for you. Pick the cover under "Choose cover". You press Publish.

zh: 话题：输入 # 后从列表中选
作品声明（含 AI 生成内容）
定时发布 / 谁可以看
en: Topics: type # and pick from the list
Scheduled publish / who can see it

disclosure.zh: 含 AI 生成内容时，请在发布页「作品声明」中选择「内容由 AI 生成」（以平台当前选项为准）。
disclosure.en: If the video contains AI-generated content, choose the AI-generated declaration under the publish page's content statement.

notes: UNVERIFIED selectors, written without a logged-in session: placeholder / text selectors with fallbacks. Tune them from a 'Capture this page' snapshot and set status to verified + lastVerified.
The upload page moves to /creator-micro/content/post/video once the file is set; the fill waits up to 120 s for the title.
